data.title: 远坂凛 · 月夜窗台的魔术师
data.description: 【远坂凛 · 月夜窗台的魔术师】清冷月光透过远坂邸卧室的落地窗洒在窗台上，凛裹着红色高领衫倚在窗框边，过膝黑丝在月色下泛着微光。她抱着手臂故作镇定地瞥了你一眼，指尖却紧张地捻着衣角——「……看什么看。不过是今晚月色不错，想在这里站一会儿而已。你要看，就站过来看个够好了。」
data.action: 倚着窗框抱臂而立，黑丝在月光下泛光
data.lighting: cold silver moonlight through window, soft red-cloth reflections, gentle night shadows
data.promptProse: Moonlight enters the Tohsaka manor as adult, age-twenty-plus Rin sits alone on a broad window seat in black thigh-highs. Her red turtleneck is rolled above bare breasts, and both hands pull one stocking down to mid-thigh while the other leg remains taut for contrast. A ruby pendant rests against her stomach and loose twin tails brush the glass. Pressure marks, curled toes and blue eyes turned aside beneath burning ears give the elegant pose physical tension. Intimate seated portrait, no text or extra people.
data.animaStyleHint: sitting_on_bed, bent_knees, black_thighhighs, barefoot, 5_toes, detailed_toes, blushing, moonlight
data.nsfwProse: Sitting on the moonlit bedroom window sill in black thigh-highs and pulled-up sweater, Rin averts her blushing gaze in flustered elegance.
